text:
Maya: kicking off AWS+GCP listing for EU/UK customers. Scope: minimal GA listing with subscription + 14-day trial, SSO provisioning via SAML, and compliance metadata (SOC2 + GDPR DPIA note). Target submission next Friday.

Leo: FYI product packaging question: AWS wants AMI + CloudFormation template; GCP prefers a container image with a Deployment Manager / Terraform snippet. Do we do both or ship a common container and build AMIs from it?

Fiona: Recommend common container image and provide provider-specific deployment artifacts. Keeps build simpler and speeds security scans. We'll still produce AMIs for AWS by baking the container into a hardened image.

Raj: Security note: marketplace requires vulnerability scan reports for images and a CVE triage plan. security-bot: do we have last scan artifacts?

security-bot: Last container CVE scan (2025-04-02) passed critical threshold; list available at https://internal.redwood/sec/artifacts/scan-20250402. AMI bake pipeline needs a fresh scan before upload.

Maya: Contracts question: do we need localized EULAs for UK separately from EU? contracts-bot?

contracts-bot: Marketplace acceptance generally allows a base EULA + regional addenda. For UK we need a Brexit addendum (data transfer/adequacy clause). I'll draft two short addenda and post by Tue.

Leo: For billing SKUs: propose simple mapping and units — subscription monthly base + tokens metered per 1k tokens for overage + embeddings per 1k. Sample: RDW-AWS-STD-MONTH, RDW-AWS-TRIAL-14D, RDW-AWS-ADDON-TOKENS. Avoid underscores per past CSP quirks.

Fiona: Add region suffix for clarity? RDW-AWS-STD-EU, RDW-GCP-STD-EU. Marketplace may require separate offers per cloud.

Raj: Also need to surface support SLA in listing: what is the response time for paid vs trial? Ops needs to confirm. Ops: can we promise <24h for paid issues and <72h for trials?

Maya: Let's default to <24h for paid, <72h for trial. We'll put escalation path in docs, not in the contract.

Leo: Packaging checklist items I need: container image digest, AMI IDs, CloudFormation/Terraform templates, SBOM, scan reports, license file, EULA addenda. Can someone own SBOM generation?

Fiona: I'll own SBOM and supply a CycloneDX JSON/SBOM link.

contracts-bot: Reminder: marketplace requires a short marketing blurb and a longer product description. Marketing should review any claims about latency/cost. @marketing please review.

Maya: I'll loop in marketing; need draft blurb by Wed noon.

security-bot: Also: KMS integration note for AWS "bring-your-own-key" option. Marketplace listing metadata should reference KMS key support if we allow BYOK. Confirm yes/no.

Raj: We support BYOK for Dedicated, but for marketplace GA let's mark BYOK supported via a partner-managed KMS option and surface limitations.

Leo: One more infra detail: image size limit for marketplace assets is strict. Keep base container <1.5GB compressed. We'll refactor heavy libs into optional layers.

Fiona: Noted. I'll thin the image and produce a build that uses on-demand model weights pull at first boot to stay under size limits. We'll provide checksum and allowlist for the download endpoint.

Maya: Timeline proposal: Tue EOD 1) contracts addenda draft; Wed AM 2) container + SBOM + scan; Wed afternoon 3) AMI bake + scan; Thu AM 4) assemble asset bundle + marketing blurb; Fri 09:00 PT 5) upload to AWS/GCP marketplace test portal; next Tue expect validation results.

Leo: I'll prepare CloudFormation and Terraform snippets by Wed noon.

Fiona: SBOM and scan links by Wed 08:30 PT.

Raj: Ops SLA doc and support contact by Wed EOD.

contracts-bot: Draft addenda posted: https://internal.redwood/contracts/marketplace-addenda-v1. Review and comment.

Maya: blockers?

Leo: Need clarity on pricing tiers for metering units. Product wants per-1000-token pricing and an embeddings bucket. Product: can you confirm numbers?

Maya: Product will publish a provisional price schedule by Tue. Also need to confirm refund policy for accidental purchases via marketplace - most markets route refunds through marketplace ops; we'll specify a contact email in listing.

security-bot: Final security checklist before upload: SBOM, container scan <48h old, AMI scan <48h old, init script hash, KMS ARN or BYOK flag, telemetry endpoint domain allowlist, and least-privilege IAM role doc.

Fiona: I'll attach SBOM + scans. Also adding a small init script snippet we use: ```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e
# pull weights only after consent and region-residency check
./fetch_weights.sh --region $REGION --consent-check
```

Maya: Okay team reconvene Thu 16:00 PT to validate the final package prior to upload. Thanks all. :rocket:
